captions.text: Maya talks to Cori on the dashboard, in the toolbar and on her AI sites.
The Cori page keeps every chat she had with him, by day, wherever it started.
Any of them opens where she left it, and she can carry on.
Search chats finds a chat by anything either of them said.
In a new chat she asks when a project is due. Cori answers from her memory.
On any page, Coere’s toolbar button opens the same Cori in a popup.
On an AI site Cori stays out of the way until she taps Right Option.
A tap brings out his chat, right beside her conversation.
Back on the Cori page, the chats from the popup and from Claude are in her history too.
Opening one shows it as it was, with the memories Cori found, in today’s words.
One Cori, one history, on every surface.
